lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Louisville businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Louisville is a river city with a global air freight hub, a large healthcare sector, a bourbon revival downtown and one horse race that reorganises the whole spring. We plan marketing around those realities and around the neighbourhoods your customers come from.

sections.heading: Derby season and the bourbon visitor
paragraphs: The Kentucky Derby is run at Churchill Downs on the first Saturday in May, but for local businesses the season starts weeks earlier with the Derby Festival, which opens with a very large fireworks and air show on the riverfront. Hotels, restaurants, caterers, florists, milliners, clothing shops and transport firms do a large part of their year's trade in that stretch.

Bourbon has given the city a year-round visitor trade as well. Distilleries and tasting rooms line Whiskey Row on Main Street and have spread into nearby districts, and many visitors use Louisville as the starting point for distillery trips into the countryside. These travellers plan ahead and search from home.
If you depend on visitors, your pages and ads should be working months before the event, booking should be easy on a phone, and your listings must show correct hours on the days that matter most.
bullets: Derby and festival pages published well ahead, and updated each year.
Ads targeted to visitors' home cities before they travel.
Short video and photography that show the experience honestly.
Business profile hours and booking links checked before every peak weekend.

sections.heading: Logistics, healthcare and manufacturing
paragraphs: UPS runs its main worldwide air hub at Louisville's airport, and that has drawn distribution centres, e-commerce fulfilment and time-sensitive shippers to the area. Healthcare is another pillar: the insurer Humana is headquartered downtown, and the city is known for companies in senior care and health services. Ford builds trucks and SUVs at two local plants, GE Appliances operates a large manufacturing campus, and several national restaurant and spirits companies are based here.

For firms that sell to these employers, the buyer is a professional comparing options. We build service pages with the detail they look for, improve search visibility for specific needs and run campaigns aimed at operations, purchasing and clinical roles. Online sellers that locate here for late shipping cut-offs need stores and ads that make the most of that advantage.

sections.heading: Neighbourhoods on both sides of the river
paragraphs: Louisville residents are loyal to their part of town. The Highlands along Bardstown Road is known for independent restaurants and shops. NuLu, on East Market Street, and neighbouring Butchertown are full of newer restaurants, galleries and boutiques. Germantown and Old Louisville, with its streets of Victorian houses, have their own character, and St. Matthews, Middletown and Jeffersontown anchor the east end.

The market also crosses the Ohio. Jeffersonville, New Albany and Clarksville in Southern Indiana are a short bridge trip from downtown, and many households live on one side and work or shop on the other. Local campaigns should name the neighbourhoods and towns you serve, include the Indiana side if you work there, and collect reviews from customers in each.

items.title: Hospitality and events
items.text: Restaurants, hotels and venues need visibility and working booking paths ahead of Derby and through bourbon season.

items.title: Distilleries and bars
items.text: Tours and tastings sell through search and social content, managed within platform rules on alcohol advertising.

items.title: Logistics and e-commerce
items.text: Fulfilment firms and online retailers near the air hub benefit from clear service pages and ads managed against margin.

items.title: Health services and senior care
items.text: Providers need trustworthy sites, accurate listings and ad wording that respects health advertising policies.

items.title: Home services
items.text: Older housing in many neighbourhoods keeps remodellers, roofers, plumbers and heating firms busy. Map results and reviews win the work.

items.title: Manufacturing suppliers
items.text: Companies serving the vehicle and appliance plants need capability pages built for procurement teams.

faqs.q: How early should I plan Derby marketing?
faqs.a: Begin in winter. Visitors book months in advance, and locals start planning parties, outfits and reservations weeks before the race. Have your pages, offers and ad campaigns ready before the festival opens, then review results afterwards for next year.

faqs.q: Should a Louisville business target Southern Indiana?
faqs.a: If you can serve customers there, yes. Many people cross the river daily. Add the Indiana towns to your service area, create a page for them and track results separately so you can see whether it pays.

faqs.q: How much does digital marketing cost in Louisville?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope of the work and the channels involved. We send a quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: Can you help a restaurant in NuLu or the Highlands?
faqs.a: Yes. For neighbourhood restaurants we focus on an accurate, active business profile, good photography, short video, review responses and ads kept to a tight local radius, widened during peak visitor weeks.
